statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-17495 (GHSA-4p3w-j4w9-5jqw) is a path traversal in moment.locale() when a non-string value is passed and moment loads a locale through Node's require. The advisory states this affects server-side npm users only, and the loader runs only when module.exports is set. This image ships moment 2.30.1 and 2.29.4 only as browser static assets (JupyterHub share/jupyterhub/static/components/moment and nbclassic static/components/moment). JupyterHub loads those files in the browser through requirejs, and the image does not include Node, so that loader cannot run.

The advisory states this affects server-side npm users only, and the loader runs only when module.exports is set. This image ships moment 2.30.1 and 2.29.4 only as browser static assets (JupyterHub share/jupyterhub/static/components/moment and nbclassic static/components/moment). JupyterHub loads those files in the browser through requirejs, and the image does not include Node, so that loader cannot run.

moment 2.31.0 fixes CVE-2026-17495, but the searchRelevanceDashboards plugin ships an isolated node_modules copy at 2.30.1. Resolutions and lockfile rewrites on that plugin do not replace the copy bundled into the plugin artifact.
